status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Isaaq.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Isaaq.

summary.en: Somali federal forces and U.S. airstrikes have killed dozens of al-Shabaab militants in Lower Shabelle, while Turkish-made missiles were identified in a deadly airstrike in Puntland, linking the conflict to external weapon supplies. The Somali government warned that Houthi support could boost al-Shabaab's attack capabilities, and the parliament speaker accused Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda of colluding with the group, while the president blamed the UAE for financing armed groups. Foreign troops are beginning to withdraw, raising concerns that al-Shabaab could expand its influence. The United States has reversed its funding for international military support to Somalia. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Somaliske føderale styrker og amerikanske luftangrep har drept dusinvis av al-Shabaab-militante i Lower Shabelle, mens tyrkiskproduserte missiler ble identifisert i et dødelig luftangrep i Puntland, noe som knytter konflikten til eksterne våpenforsyninger. Den somaliske regjeringen advarte om at houthi-støtte kan øke al-Shabaab sin angrepskapasitet, og parlamentets talsperson anklaget Kenya, Etiopia og Uganda for å samarbeide med gruppen, mens presidenten la skylden på De forente arabiske emirater for å finansiere væpnede grupper. Utenlandske tropper begynner å trekke seg tilbake, noe som gir bekymring for at al-Shabaab kan utvide sin innflytelse. USA har reversert sin finansiering av internasjonal militær støtte til Somalia. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
